description: SFLOW semi-implicit step with the coupled non-hydrostatic pressure (A 210 12, A 220 3) and wetting and drying (A 243 2, Newton iteration on the wet pattern): solitary wave H/d = 0.0185, d = 1 m, run-up on a 1:19.85 beach (Synolakis 1987), dx = 5 cm, dt = 0.05 s. 30 s: the wave climbs the beach and runs down again.
covers: sflow_momentum_SI_nh with the wet-pattern Newton iteration
